plan.change: Build independent Feel Studio 0.1 with three mechanics, direct scene editing, immutable variants, replay, real component composition and manual AI handoff.
expectedChanges: One new work, using the unchanged MotionRunner input/lifecycle/fixed-step adapter
Three genuinely different drivers: inertial force, spring tether, frictional bristle; separate collision restitution and coast/viscous/dry stopping
Edit shared terrain/start position and per-variant pull strength directly on canvas; switch/retry with zero dynamic state
Keep immutable saved snapshots and working drafts; apply identical recorded pointer frames from one frozen scene
Compose independently implemented bounce/stop components into a playable saved child with provenance
Export/import strict versioned JSON plus human handoff; no automatic communication
Append one active/staging-only Lifecycle entry and regenerate LAB with unchanged generator
ownerDecisions: 2026-10-12 user Feel Studio 0.1 request explicitly authorizes design, implementation, tests, isolated branch/PR, safe Staging merge and URL confirmation; excludes Production and completed PUMPOKO.
hqDecisions: Technical scope review: existing Lifecycle/LAB consistency requires registry and generated LAB alongside the isolated work. No schema, generator, Engine, shared UI or save contract changes. Work-owned namespace and adapter suffice.
rulesApplied: AGENTS: active/staging-only; no production promotion or town installation
CHANGE-PLAN Full risk floor for lifecycle JSON and generated LAB; lock first
Existing MotionRunner handles pointers/visibility/resize/120Hz; no new common runtime
Record test environment truthfully; no physical iPhone claim
manualChecks: Direct edit, branching save, restore and actual bounce/stop combination
plan.rollback: Revert this PR: new work, appended lifecycle entry, generated LAB and lock. No migration of old saves.
outOfScope: Existing works or shared Engine edits
unverified: Physical iPhone/iPad Safari feel and performance
Real browser visual QA unless a supported browser becomes available
plan.problem: Text-only AI iteration makes tactile comparison and partial adoption slow.
plan.currentContract: Motion Lab offers Runner and versioned specimens; Engine offers diagnostic reports and live tuning; 3D has direct manipulation. None provides simultaneous branches and real component choices.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: A work-local studio session layer and adapter enable comparison without changing established runtimes.
plan.design: A quiet miniature desk with a wooden disc and editable terrain; A/B/C beneath a large canvas, optional tools, exact immutable snapshots and structured handoff.
plan.migration: New namespace only. One new active entry; unchanged generator refreshes LAB.
plan.compatibility: Read-only MotionRunner dependency; independent UMD model/session modules; no runtime, storage key, launch or URL edits to existing works.
plan.promotionRisk: CI and Staging availability are distinct from physical device verification and owner adoption.
alternativesRejected: Do not duplicate Engine or add global tunables
Do not pretend arbitrary mechanic synthesis
Do not change workflows merely to run new tests

Same-input comparison across distinct force mappings
testPlan: Execute deterministic models and session scenarios in available JS runtime
